items.t: District: Records for 1,800 Lake County students mistakenly shared with unauthorized person
items.x: Lake County Schools said late Friday in a Facebook post that student records of approximately 1,800 students had been mistakenly sent to someone who was not authorized to have them.

items.t: Confidential records of 1,800 Lake County students inadvertently shared, district says
items.x: Confidential education records of about 1,800 Lake County students have been inadvertently shared with an individual who was not authorized to receive them, the district said Friday.
